title: Solana Subscriptions plan metadata (v1)
description: Display metadata for a Subscriptions program plan, referenced by the plan's on-chain `metadataUri` (128 bytes). Either host this document and put its https URL in `metadataUri`, or put the compact form inline. Price, token, period, destinations and pullers are deliberately absent: they are authoritative on-chain, and clients must read them from the plan account, never from metadata.

document.title: Full document
document.description: The form for a hosted JSON file. Field names follow the Metaplex token metadata convention where one exists.

image.description: Logo or artwork (https, ipfs or ar).

icon.description: Named icon, for UIs that ship an icon set (the reference webapp uses Lucide names such as "Star").

external_url.description: The merchant's page for this plan.

terms_url.description: Terms of service for the subscription.

support_url.description: Where subscribers get help or manage billing questions.

features.description: What the plan includes, in display order.

attributes.description: Free-form key/values for integrations, e.g. an external price ID.

compact.title: Compact inline form
compact.description: For storing metadata directly in the 128-byte `metadataUri`, as the reference webapp does. Single-letter keys: n = name, d = description, i = icon, w = external_url. Any other key is an attribute.

examples.name: Pro
examples.description: Unlimited API calls and priority support.
